title: ApprovalRequest
description: A reviewer marks the head version of a building `APPROVED` (v0.3 §8.1; spec §11 r8; D-3D24-1). Not a command: it makes no model version. The building is named by the route; the lease by the `X-3DQM-Lease` header (D-403, D-3D24-5).
$comment: [P] Shape (D-3D24-6). `expectedVersion` is the version the reviewer saw: another head -> 409 VERSION_CONFLICT.
